title: Crowd waiting for Parade 44100 hz June 5 2026 by kvgarlic
author: kvgarlic
sourceDescription: On Friday June 5, 2026 I recorded a parade in southern Illinois. This parade was in honor of the 200th birthday of General John A Logan who fought in the US Civil War. After I set up my rig and did some test recordings I pushed the stop button, and just admired the smiles on the families and kids as they gathered around waiting for the parade to roll.
